name: template-skill
tagline_zh: 别从零写技能了！复制这个模板，填上描述，Claude 立刻懂何时用、怎么用。省下半小时，少踩十个坑。
tagline_en: Stop reinventing skills. Copy this template, fill in the description, and Claude knows when and how to use it.
desc_en: Replace with description of the skill and when Claude should use it.
why_zh: 同类模板只给骨架，它连「何时触发」的决策逻辑都替你铺好，照着填就能跑。
why_en: Unlike bare skeletons, it pre-wires the 'when-to-use' logic, so you just fill in the blanks and it works.
